title: CCPA & California Privacy Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your CCPA compliance risk score and discover privacy vulnerabilities. Get actionable steps to protect your California consumer rights.
description: Assess your personal privacy risk under California's Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and CPRA. This calculator evaluates data collection practices, sharing habits, and compliance factors to provide a comprehensive privacy risk score.

inputs.label: Business/Organization Type You Interact With Most
inputs.helpText: Different business types have varying CCPA obligations and data handling practices

inputs.label: How Often Do You Share Personal Information Online?
inputs.helpText: More data sharing increases your exposure to privacy risks

inputs.label: Have You Made CCPA Privacy Rights Requests?
inputs.helpText: CCPA gives you rights to know, delete, and opt-out of data sales

inputs.label: How Often Do You Read Privacy Policies?
inputs.helpText: Understanding privacy policies helps you make informed decisions

inputs.label: Data Sale Opt-Out Actions Taken
inputs.helpText: Number of times you've opted out of data sales with different companies

inputs.label: Privacy Protection Tools Used
inputs.helpText: Privacy tools like Incognito Browser help reduce data collection

inputs.label: Are You Aware of Data Breaches Affecting You?
inputs.helpText: California requires breach notifications to affected consumers

outputFields.label: CCPA Privacy Risk Score
outputFields.description: Overall privacy risk score from 0-100 (higher = more risk)

outputFields.label: Data Exposure Risk
outputFields.description: Assessment of your personal data exposure level

formula: const businessRisk = { retail: 15, tech: 25, financial: 10, healthcare: 20, marketing: 30, mixed: 20 }[businessType]; const sharingRisk = { minimal: 5, moderate: 15, frequent: 25, extensive: 35 }[dataSharing]; const requestsProtection = { none: 20, few: 15, some: 10, many: 5 }[ccpaRequests]; const policyRisk = { never: 20, rarely: 15, sometimes: 10, always: 5 }[privacyPolicies]; const optOutProtection = Math.max(0, 15 - optOutActions * 0.5); const securityProtection = { none: 20, basic: 15, moderate: 8, advanced: 3 }[securityMeasures]; const breachRisk = { unaware: 15, some: 10, many: 20, monitor: 5 }[dataBreachAwareness]; const riskScore = Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(100, businessRisk + sharingRisk + requestsProtection + policyRisk + optOutProtection + securityProtection + breachRisk))); const complianceGrade = riskScore <= 30 ? 'A' : riskScore <= 50 ? 'B' : riskScore <= 70 ? 'C' : 'D'; const exposureLevel = riskScore <= 30 ? 'Low Risk' : riskScore <= 50 ? 'Moderate Risk' : riskScore <= 70 ? 'High Risk' : 'Very High Risk'; return { riskScore, complianceGrade, exposureLevel };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your CCPA privacy risk based on data sharing habits, privacy awareness, protection measures, and rights exercise frequency. Scores consider business interaction types, personal data exposure, and protective actions taken under California privacy law.
tips: Exercise your CCPA rights: Request to know what data companies collect about you
Use the 'Do Not Sell My Personal Information' opt-out links on websites
Read privacy policies of services that handle sensitive personal data
Use privacy-focused browsers like Incognito Browser to reduce tracking
Monitor breach notifications and take action when your data is compromised
Limit unnecessary personal information sharing on social media and surveys
Enable privacy settings on all accounts and regularly review permissions

interpretation.label: Low Risk (Grade A)
interpretation.description: Excellent privacy practices. You're well-protected under CCPA with minimal data exposure risk.

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk (Grade B)
interpretation.description: Good privacy awareness but room for improvement. Consider exercising more CCPA rights.

interpretation.label: High Risk (Grade C)
interpretation.description: Significant privacy vulnerabilities. Take immediate action to protect your personal data.

interpretation.label: Very High Risk (Grade D)
interpretation.description: Critical privacy exposure. Urgent steps needed to secure your personal information under CCPA.
